newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Konecranes 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Konecranes 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 188 million markka median forecast for cranes maker KCI Konecranes International Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(EPS forecasts by 14 analysts, profit forecasts by 15).
Konecranes' results are due on February 5 at 1000/0800 GMT.
In 1995, Konecranes had a 135 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Ten of the 15 analysts polled gave forecasts for Konecranes' dividend for 1996 with the median at 2.60 markka (mean 2.70 markka) in a 2.40-3.50 markka range. The 1995 dividend was 2.00 markka.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 10 of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 225 million markka (mean 229 million) in a 209-254 million markka range. @

Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
